slides.title: Where is each plan now?
slides.support: Everyone below A has a plan. Each leader answers for their own team.
body: For each B: how are you coaching them to A?
Has any A fallen back to B?
For each C: what action have you taken?
notes: The team placed every direct report last quarter and wrote a plan for everyone below A. This is the check on those plans.
A leader scores as the lowest score on their team. Leave a B in place and you become one.
Talk about the Bs and how each is being coached to A, and any A who has slipped. For each C, the leader says what has been done.
The plan will hold the company back from its goals if leaders do not act on people. Any plan without movement goes on the homework list with a date.
The CEO’s own assessment of the leadership team stays private.
